create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance that sets up the training pipeline with Adam optimizer and logging
run_Trainer_make_batch_generator: run the Trainer _make_batch_generator method to construct a DataLoader for the training dataset
run_Trainer_make_model: run the Trainer _make_model method to build the model graph and optimizer for training
test_Trainer_set_lr: test the Trainer set_lr method to adjust learning rate based on epoch and decay schedule
run_Tester_evaluate: run the Tester _evaluate method to evaluate model predictions against the test dataset
